blockers: Only Backgrounds and Merits/Flaws have been promoted to a production catalog so far (77 of 207); Charms, Weaving Protocols, Alchemy Formulae, Clarity, submodule installation, and Charm-slot mechanics are still unimplemented.
Rules, guided-creator, migration, and browser test suites have not been run for this family yet.

Allies, Contacts, and Mentor remain deliberately unresolved for Alchemical's Backgrounds catalog: Exalted: The Autochthonians never mentions these three shared ids in either direction, unlike Lunar's own Background section, which explicitly confirms its unaltered shared ids remain available. They are held out rather than guessed; see alchemicalBackgrounds's doc comment in definitions.ts.
notes: Exalted: The Autochthonians supplied and inventory complete cover-to-cover. 207 rows reviewed and inventoried under docs/references/exalted1e/alchemical/inventory/: the Chapter Two character-creation overview (plus bonus-point/experience-cost tables), the universal Anima Effect/Anima Banner table, the Alchemical Physiology section (Artificial Metabolism, Life and Death, Refitting/Essence Advancement/Evolution), all five Castes (Orichalcum, Moonsilver, Jade, Starmetal, Soulsteel) plus the apocryphal Adamant Caste sidebar, the full Clarity Trait (gain/loss/effects table) and its Dissonance/Gremlin Syndrome mirror, the new/altered Backgrounds (Class, Vats, Artifact, Backing, Familiar, Manse) plus the Building Vats in Creation sidebar and the Followers/Influence/Resources exclusion note, all of Chapter Three (pp. 87-141/PDF 88-142, 94 Charms across all nine Charm trees plus the two General Charms and the Charm-system framing), the full Chapter Four weaving-protocol catalog (49 rows, printed pp. 142-159/PDF 143-160), the rest of Chapter Four's character-facing material (31 rows: the three Autochthonian-only alchemy formulae, the full Autochthonian Technology artifact catalog, and the full Warfare and Transportation sections, completing all of Chapter Four), and the adventure-seed Chapters Five through Seven (reviewed and confirmed almost entirely GM/NPC/plot content, contributing exactly one more player-facing item, the Steamcar Refurbished vehicle). Chapter Four's Storyteller-side lore/NPC/setting material and Chapters Five-Seven's adventure narrative were reviewed and intentionally excluded as out of character-creation scope. No Alchemical-specific Merits/Flaws were found beyond Gremlin Syndrome/Dissonance anywhere in the book itself. A second source book, the Exalted Players Guide, closes the universal Merits & Flaws gap: 70 more rows (35 merits + 35 flaws) were derived from Lunar's already-verified transcription of that book's universal Chapter One (88 pg- rows total across all five planned families), evaluating each row's own splat-eligibility notes against Alchemical's core-book rules; 18 of the 88 were skipped as inapplicable to a soulless, vat-built construct Exalt (explicit other-splat-only restrictions, or ruled out by lacking blood lineage/reincarnation/Sorcery access/a childhood phase/being already permanently sterile). Several included rows were adapted for Alchemical's construct nature (chassis damage instead of flesh scarring, Class instead of Resources, a benefactor instead of parents, Clarity instead of the Great Curse, and a note that Sun-Seared and Hidden Manse are only fully relevant once a story reaches Creation), each flagged in that row's own notes. Two more small universal artifact catalogs were added afterward: six rows (Ghost Cestus, Sling Bow of Ice, The Golden Viper, Land Ship, Singing Staff, Eye of Autochthon) derived unchanged from Lunar's already-verified transcription of the Exalted Storyteller's Companion's universal Chapter Four 'Further Wonders' catalog, transferring cleanly except for two flagged judgment calls (The Golden Viper's flesh-to-gold bite is ambiguous for a vat-built frame; the Eye of Autochthon's Creation-native powers, despite its thematic tie to Autochthon himself, are only meaningful once a story reaches Creation); and eight rows freshly transcribed from Savage Seas' 'Artifacts of the Waves' naval catalog (Cargo Preservation Spindles, Armor of Aquatic Puissance, Steelsilk Sails, Storm Sapphire, Cord of Winds, Wavecleaver Daiklaive, Light Implosion Bow, Lightning Ballista), each kept selectable but flagged with an Autochthonia-has-no-Creation-style-oceans caveat mirroring the Sun-Seared/Hidden Manse precedent. 291 total rows now inventoried; nothing promoted to a production catalog yet. Locked pending schema/rules/creator/editor implementation and passing tests across all five planned families. A final cross-splat supplement-triage pass added 14 rows (291 -> 305) from Exalted: Blood and Salt: a Lintha-connection Character Backgrounds reinterpretation sidebar, a Bluehaven approach-navigation rule, four regional Character Concepts lists, seven new Artifacts (including the Talisman of the Cult of Dukantha, which grants Infernal sorcery access), one new Hearthstone (Jewel of Stability), three mundane equipment items; the rest of the book's NPC/monster stat-block material was reviewed and confirmed out of scope, and four reprinted artifacts (plus, where applicable, a reprinted Hearthstone and two reprinted/superseded spells) received citation notes on their existing rows rather than new duplicate rows. promotableEntries (207) is a preliminary keyword-based estimate of rows meant to become a strict catalog entry (Charms/Submodules, Merits/Flaws including Alchemical-only Dissonance variants, Backgrounds -- no Sorcery, per this splat's no-Sorcery design), matching Abyssal's approach in verification.ts. This has not been verified against a real built catalog and should be treated as approximate until Alchemical's own schema/catalog phase recomputes it precisely. Phase 1a (schema wiring plus Backgrounds and Merits/Flaws catalog promotion) added `'alchemical'` to `exaltedSheetTypes` in definitions.ts, making it a legal, schema-validated stored `sheetType` for the first time, without adding it to `definition.tsx`'s `variants` -- it remains unreachable through the character-creation UI, exactly like Lunar, Abyssal, and Sidereal before their own later UI phases. `promotedEntries` (77) breaks down as 6 Backgrounds ids (`alchemicalBackgrounds` in definitions.ts: the two wholly new ids Class and Vats from Exalted: The Autochthonians Chapter Two's 'Expanded Backgrounds,' plus the four altered shared ids Artifact, Backing, Familiar, and Manse, each carrying Alchemical-specific mechanics per that same section) plus 71 Merits/Flaws entries in the shared `dragonblooded-merits-flaws.json` catalog now carrying `'alchemical'` in `appliesTo` (`alchemicalOnlyTraits`). Those 71 catalog entries resolve the 70 `pg-merit-*`/`pg-flaw-*` inventory rows one-for-one, except the single inventoried 'Favor' row, which maps onto the catalog's existing `favor-merit`/`favor-flaw` split pair (hence 70 rows -> 71 catalog entries); no wholly new Alchemical-only catalog entries were needed, since every row the inventory's own judgment-call notes adapted (chassis damage instead of flesh scarring, Class instead of Resources, a benefactor instead of parents, etc.) kept its underlying mechanic and point cost unchanged, reframing flavor text only. Cross-checked the Destiny Merit specifically, since Abyssal/Sidereal both needed a `sharedCostOverrides` entry for it: the Players Guide's own 'Destiny and Exaltation' sidebar names Alchemical Exalted (alongside Dragon-Blooded) as explicitly uncapped, so Alchemical correctly falls through to the shared Dragon-Blooded-derived 1-5 point range with no override entry required, unlike Abyssal's and Sidereal's narrower 1-2 point cap. Deliberately excluded three shared Background ids -- Allies, Contacts, and Mentor -- from `alchemicalBackgrounds` despite their silent availability in Lunar's own equivalent list: Exalted: The Autochthonians' 'Expanded Backgrounds' section is an exhaustive catalog of every departure from the default framework (two additions, four alterations, one explicit three-Background exclusion folding Followers/Influence/Resources into Class), and never mentions these three ids in either direction, unlike Lunar's own text, which affirmatively confirms its unaltered shared ids remain available. Rather than guess, this project's 'never fabricate mechanics not confirmed in inventoried source text' rule holds these three back as an explicitly tracked open blocker pending a source that actually settles the question. Alchemical's Charms (94 rows), Weaving Protocols (49 rows), Alchemy Formulae, and the Clarity/submodule-installation Charm-slot subsystem remain completely out of scope for this phase -- `charmIdsBySheetType` in schema.ts still carries only a placeholder empty `Set()` for `alchemical`, so a blank Alchemical character validates with zero Charm/Combo/spell selections but any non-empty selection is correctly rejected as unknown, exactly matching how Lunar's own Charms were unimplemented before its later Phase 1b.
